General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transfer Case Gear Shifter Outer Shift Rod SPRING
This Spring is part of the Shifter Mechanism and is the Outer Spring that holds the Smaller metal Balls against the Front Drive Shifting Shaft and the Reduction Shifting Shaft.
The Shifting Rods Require 2 of these Springs.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Spring (Outer)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
